propositions: Focused prerequisite-consistency criterion must route prerequisite pairs through isolated finder and verifier prompts that receive no general-review material and produce schema-valid coverage records with exactly one disposition per readable pinned prerequisite ID.

Stable packing must preserve whole subject and prerequisite blocks without splitting plan text; context-limit recovery applies only to findings tuples within a single prerequisite record, with recursive half-split and model escalation before indeterminate/evaluation-error emission.

Finding identity encoding for prerequisite-scoped findings must use length-prefixed UTF-8 fields (version, text, sorted criteria, canonical ID) with SHA-256 hashing; all non-prerequisite findings retain the existing pipe-delimited encoding byte-for-byte.

Any indeterminate prerequisite coverage record must force top-level unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict with prerequisite_indeterminate=true, while concurrent DET blockers remain visibly retained in the blocking array and reclassified non-DET blockers move to indeterminate with reason=prerequisite-coverage-indeterminate.

Focused Pass-2 verifier must evaluate each finding's attribution independently against its authoritative prerequisite plan block and the subject plan, emitting yes|no|na for prerequisite_attribution_valid with no=missing-or-wrong-attribution blocking the finding from upstream incompatibility.

Singleton phase must reach recall≥0.90, false-acceptance≤0.10, coverage=1.00, attribution-error=0.00 and establish a pinned baseline before packed calls proceed; packed calls must not regress against the baseline while maintaining absolute floors and complete coverage.
